rejected_candidate_statement: For every canonical ordinary CNF with m<=7, eliminating the v0.5 minimum-incidence pivot preserves m<=7.

counterexample.reason: The six positive resolvents are pairwise distinct; both retained clauses have incompatible sign patterns and are neither duplicates nor supersets removed by those resolvents.

conclusion: The proved m<=6 invariant must not be generalized to m<=7. Any N49 proof must use reachable-state structure rather than an m<=7 invariant.
